_doc: THE keystone — the single source of truth for the MC agent roster. Each role carries: identity (name·call_sign·true_name·home·tier·kind), the model map (provider·model·effort·fallback), dispatch authority (dispatchable_by·dispatches·build_chain), review semantics (review_scope·binding_verdict·claude_pinned), multiplicity, the target spec path, and the named enforcer. Routers + enforcers READ FROM HERE so a rename/swap is ONE edit (catalog.js·providers.js·state.js·org-roles.js·team-guard·dispatch-route-guard·gauntlet-verify + the RESULT schemas derive from this, gated by scan:role-parity + scan:dispatch-routing-parity). The REPORTING-LINE STRUCTURE is SINGLE-SOURCED HERE — `home`/`sub_home` (which department/pod a role reports into) + `dispatchable_by` (its managers) ARE the org reporting structure; scan:role-parity verifies them against the INDEPENDENT on-disk spec tree (department-dir = home, pod-dir = sub_home, frontmatter name = role id) so the check is non-vacuous. org-map.json's `domains{}` roster is a non-authoritative legacy view. org-map.role_registry points here. DO NOT add a role here unless its spec resolves under .claude/agents/.
supersedes_note: This registry's home/sub_home/dispatchable_by SUPERSEDE org-map.json's `domains{}` reporting-line view as the single structural source (verified vs the spec tree by scan:role-parity). org-map.json v0.1 is kept for its `gauntlets`/`routing`/`claims_boundary` views + a legacy `domains{}` view.

model_policy._doc: Reviewers are ≥-capable AND on a DIFFERENT provider/family than the doer they review (cross-provider diversity); doers & fixers share the doer model. INTENTIONAL CHAIN: claude-fable-5-1 is the TOP brain (President α, Director-of-Engineering) at `high`; `max` is used only by the security Claude HUNTER lane (opus-4-8@max, security-reviewer.third_pass); builders+fixers run claude-sonnet-5-5@high; the deliver-face conductors (γ/δ/ε) run xhigh; authors (Design/Product/Copy/Conversion leads, qa-reviewer) run xhigh, overseers/judges (Directors, β, security judge, marketing-lead) run high; `ultra` is gated to gpt-5.6 sol/terra (no live role pins it — Cabinet and Ops-Analyst run xhigh); Product+Growth route to GPT (gpt-6 / gpt-6.1 sol), Engineering stays Claude, the security Gemini lab routes through antigravity/agy (gemini individual CLI sunset); gemini/antigravity have no effort flag (thinking always-on → effort null). tool roles scale down (test-runner sonnet-5-5@medium, skeleton-builder null). For in-process roles (Agent-tool spawn) effort is documented intent; for CLI-routed roles (dispatch-agent.js) effort is live. Machine-enforced by scan:model-chain (scripts/checks/model-chain.js). OPUS TIER: claude-opus-5 is PROVEN served on the CLI channel ONLY (not harness Agent-tool-spawnable yet) — so every IN-PROCESS opus role pin here (γ/δ/ε, quality/frontend/backend/security leads, design-quality, visual-review, security-reviewer.third_pass, security_claude_hunter) is pinned to claude-opus-4-8. opus-4-8 stays a served catalog member. claude-opus-5-5 is option-only — the provider default + `opus` alias and every in-process pin stay claude-opus-4-8; the sonnet-5-5 doers/builders and fable-5-1 (alpha/DoE) are CLI-dispatched with explicit effort. Invariant (opus-5 is thinking-on by default; disabled-thinking 400s at xhigh/max): any Claude lane at effort xhigh/max must keep thinking ON — model-chain.js THINKING-400 check.

security_2nd_pass._doc: the mandated 2nd-GPT security pass (Gemini corpus-diverse + OpenAI jailbreak-tuned) — a dispatch behavior (runProvider opts.provider override), not a separate role.

carve_outs._doc: Recorded so a future parity scan does NOT 'fix' these as violations.
carve_outs.claude_pinned_visual_review: design-quality + visual-review are pinned to Claude because their judgment is VISUAL (Playwright-MCP); independence is the BINDING VERDICT (they grade, don't author), not provider diversity. A sanctioned exception to cross-provider-diversity.
carve_outs.cross_provider_is_a_dispatch_property: A reviewer carries its provider assignment in this registry — diversity is a dispatch property of the Reviewer, not a separate agent type.

tiers.face: Alex's mode-selected faces — one identity, singletons. NOT separate org titles.
tiers.lead: owns a function/pod — singleton; scales by fanning out workers, never by cloning itself.
tiers.worker: Builder/Reviewer/Fixer — multi-instance fan-out, each in its own worktree, each a binding verdict.

alpha._note: the top brain — claude-fable-5 @ high. Runs as the harness session; catalog effort is documented intent (operationally set by /effort). `max` is reserved for the security Claude hunter lane (security-reviewer.third_pass opus@max).

beta.dispatch_path: on-demand CLI consult per phase boundary (dispatch-agent.js / codex exec) — NOT an in-process Claude teammate
beta._note: a model bump does NOT fix canned verdicts.

epsilon._note: sprint conductor — reads the hook-point registry {role,step,condition,mode,order} and runs plan→design→build→gauntlet→release→retro; managers self-dispatch their phases. INHERITS δ's heartbeat + 30-min-stale circuit-breaker (ε runs long like δ).

product-lead._note: authors PRD/stories/AC; co-authors the mockup with design-lead.

design-lead.dispatch_path: subprocess-consult (dispatch-agent.js / codex exec) — NOT an in-process Claude teammate
design-lead._note: A product-design role on GPT (gpt-5.6-sol; best at product design/UX/flows). Owns UI/UX authoring + mockups; routine microcopy from _knowledge/copy. AUTHORS — judged by quality-lead's design-quality (no self-judging).

quality-lead._note: broadened: functional + UI/UX experience; dispatches QA Reviewers. tools:Agent required to fan out QA-Reviewer personas.

qa-reviewer.review_scope: traceability (the 6 req-reviewer checks: behavior↔req↔code↔test · contract-propagation · risk-class agreement · drift hygiene) + integrity (compliance: COPY.md exact-match · hallucinated_dep · 5 violation types · cross-provider) + functional (the 13 qa personas: scan 1-7 + analyze 8-13 + flow_traces/data_flows/state_diffs)
qa-reviewer._note: ABSORBS req-reviewer + compliance as review SCOPES (pod reviewers = code-quality only). Port Tier-3 verbatim: holdout-fixture is the reviewer's, the 6 traceability checks + BLOCKING rule (risk_class_disagreement / contract_propagation_missed override the panel) are req-reviewer's, COPY exact-match + hallucinated_dep are compliance's. GPT-pinned (gpt-5.6-terra) + CLI-routed — the 13 personas run inline in the single CLI context; Agent-tool fan-out dropped per the no-Agent-on-a-non-claude-role rule (quality-lead remains the claude in-process fan-out layer).

design-quality.review_scope: design-tokens · component-usage · visual-hierarchy · mobile-responsive · accessibility · design-handoff (cross-domain: app-design Product + web-design Growth)

visual-review._note: CARVE-OUT: Claude-pinned (Playwright-MCP). dedup scope vs design-quality during build.

director-of-engineering._note: DoE-as-ORCHESTRATOR: dispatches the pods, inherits γ's dispatch independence; invariant = no self-judging + cannot override a FAIL; gauntlet roster registry-FIXED, not DoE-chosen.

frontend-reviewer.review_scope: code-quality only (Check-7 7A-7G + holdout-fixture step-expectations/golden.json + CWD/branch pre-check). Traceability/integrity moved to qa-reviewer.
frontend-reviewer._note: cross-provider vs the Claude FE builder.

frontend-fixer._note: fix-one-brief ≤3 attempts; Fixer authors → frontend-reviewer RE-RUNS after every fix.

panel_judge._note_2: Gauntlet claude lanes dispatch claude-opus-5, NOT claude-fable-5; when the openai breaker is tripped, openai lanes fall back to claude-opus-5

third_pass._role: Claude hunter lane — in-process-agent is the ONE legal claude shape for a cross_provider_reviewer; summoned by ε via the Agent tool + record-inprocess

security-reviewer.review_scope: OWASP · authn/z · injection · secrets · attack-chain-correlator (3 MEDIUM → CRITICAL) · prompt-injection-prober
security-reviewer.scan_mode: ALL deterministic — NO LLM reasoning (a security guarantee that must not erode)
security-reviewer._note: 3-LAB PANEL: planner+final judge = claude-fable-5 (in-process); three HUNTER labs fired in order — Gemini via antigravity/agy (primary) → gpt-5.6-sol jailbreak (second_pass, CLI) → claude-opus-4-8@max (third_pass, IN-PROCESS: the one legal claude shape for the class). FAILS CLOSED on lab-diversity loss (a hunter falling back to Claude collapses the cross-lab guarantee → re-run or BLOCK). gemini individual CLI is SUNSET → the Gemini lab routes through agy. dispatch-review.js fires the CLI passes; the Claude hunter + fable judge are summoned in-process by ε (record-inprocess), NOT dispatched as a refused subprocess-claude.

security_claude_hunter.review_scope: OWASP · authn/z · injection · secrets · attack-chain-correlator · prompt-injection-prober (the claude hunter lane, =security-reviewer.third_pass)
security_claude_hunter.scan_mode: ALL deterministic — NO LLM reasoning (security guarantee, ported from security-reviewer)
security_claude_hunter.enforcer: provenance-verifier (writer-stamped identity) + record-inprocess refusal path + provenance-invariants delegation guard
security_claude_hunter._role: the REAL registered producer for the panel-3lab BINDING claude lane. Mirrors security-reviewer.third_pass (claude-opus-4-8, in-process). Summoned by the panel-run CONDUCTOR (alpha-as-epsilon OR teammate-epsilon SYNCHRONOUS Agent spawn; run_in_background:false — spawn-synchronously-or-BLOCK) + record-inprocess, which WRITER-STAMPS role=security_claude_hunter + shape=in-process-agent (non-settable identity). effort:null at top level — the max-effort policy reserves top-level max for alpha, so opus@max is carried by security-reviewer.third_pass (authoritative) + applied by epsilon at panel time. Registration proves NOTHING; binding-green needs ONE real same-run fallback:false hunter record + the negative fixtures landing BLOCKED. No synthetic-record path: an unregistered/unstamped record -> record-inprocess refuses.

director-of-growth._note: Growth department (research + message + conversion + paid); owns message coherence.

research-lead._note: audience research → shared _knowledge/audience (segment-level, source-attributed, confidence-scored, no PII).

copy-lead._note: owns voice + high-leverage copy; seeds _knowledge/copy; authors COPY.md contract for builders.

marketing-lead._note: paid media · campaigns · EQ scoring (SCALE/TEST/SKIP) · LTV:CAC.

ops-analyst._note: President's office. Cross-cycle learning / between-cycle auditor loop; cross-provider meta-review (sees Claude builder/reviewer shared blind spots). Legacy ids learner/auditor resolve via role-aliases; REASONING_LEARNER honored via readReasoningEnv legacy-name pattern.

skeleton-builder._note: Skeleton stub regen on Sonnet (not Haiku) for signature fidelity. effort null to match live dispatch (catalog DEFAULT_EFFORT_PER_ROLE). build_chain (goes through dispatch-claude.js). Legacy id stub-scaffold resolves via role-aliases.

cabinet._note: the registered freeform cross-provider second-opinion / outside-counsel role (President's office). NO strict output schema (freeform) — dispatch-agent.js FREEFORM_ROLES skips envelope validation so a freeform reply doesn't trip the review-envelope validator or distort review-role telemetry. Legacy ids advisor/consult resolve via role-aliases.

scrapped._doc: Retired roles. A no-stray assertion: scan:role-parity + scan:dispatch-routing-parity + a fresh subagent_type enumeration must show ZERO of these.
scrapped.qa: monolithic qa agent — restructured into qa-reviewer (dispatched by quality-lead).
scrapped.redteam: redteam agent — restructured into security-reviewer (dispatched by security-lead).
